description: The project config sets check_commands to `python3 tools/check_docstrings.py`, and the check already fails on main: textstats/slugs.py, which is not in T-1.2's Files, raises ValueError without naming it. The skill runs the check before editing anything and stops with the failed-check line. It does not fix slugs.py, which is outside the task, and it changes and commits nothing.

must_match.pattern: \AT-1\.2 check failed: python3 tools/check_docstrings\.py: .*slug.*\. Status stays Todo; the changes are left uncommitted\.\s*\Z
must_match.why: the failed-check stop line, naming the check command and what it reported, is the whole reply
the check command is run to find out

must_not_match.why: the check ran and failed; nothing it needs is missing
nothing is edited: slugs.py is outside the task's Files, and the check fails before the task's own change
nothing is pushed, stashed, or reset

manual: After the run, git status --porcelain shows nothing, and tasks.md still has T-1.2 as Todo.
The trace has no Edit or Write, and no Bash command that changes textstats/slugs.py.
